arguments.name: str
arguments.text: Character vector of strings to search.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Character vector of regular expressions. An empty pattern is not supported.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Character vector of ICU replacement strings. $1 and ${name} are capture groups.

arguments.name: opts_regex
arguments.text: A list of regex settings, or NULL for the defaults.

origin.details: A missing string or pattern, or an empty pattern, yields a missing result, and an empty pattern warns. An empty string is searched. The inputs are recycled to the longer length. Replacement uses ICU syntax: $1 and ${name} are capture groups, and \\1 is also a group. A missing replacement yields NA when the pattern matches and leaves the string unchanged otherwise. opts_regex holds only the settings that were supplied. Named arguments are merged into that dict and passed through stri_opts_regex. A repeated name is an error. An unknown name in a bare dict warns and is ignored. case_insensitive, comments, dotall (also dot_all), literal, multiline (also multi_line), unix_lines, and uword are ICU flags. error_on_unknown_escapes rejects an unknown backslash. time_limit and stack_limit are applied only when they are positive. A miss returns the original string.

arguments.name: str
arguments.text: String, missing value, or list of those.

arguments.name: pattern
arguments.text: Regular expression, missing value, or list of those. An empty pattern yields NA.

arguments.name: replacement
arguments.text: Replacement string, missing value, or list of those. $1 and ${name} are capture groups.

arguments.name: opts_regex
arguments.text: None, or a dict of only the regex settings that were supplied.
